$comment: Adi-Vritti shared design tokens. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for status colors and plain-language UI words across officer-web (Next.js) and mobile (Expo). Values mirror services/core FailureDecoder + docs/openapi/core.yaml semantics — plain words here must never contradict backend meanings.

vocabulary.$comment: Technical term -> words shown in UI. Technical code stays in mono caption only.

sla.$comment: Thresholds mirror officer-web slaStatus(elapsed, limit): breached when elapsed > limit, at-risk when elapsed >= limit - 1.

expired.detail: Validity ended — fetch a fresh copy

expiring.detail: Renews soon — refetch before it lapses

stp.$comment: Straight-through-processing score bands. >=85 auto-approvable (matches exceptions page threshold).

failureFixes.$comment: cause+fix are backend-exact (services/core FailureDecoder.java). short is the judge-friendly headline. NEVER change cause/fix without the backend.

E001_AADHAAR_NOT_SEEDED.cause: Aadhaar not seeded with bank account
E001_AADHAAR_NOT_SEEDED.fix: Visit the nearest bank branch with your Aadhaar card and ask for Aadhaar seeding (NPCI mapping).

E002_ACCOUNT_DORMANT.fix: One deposit or withdrawal reactivates it — visit the branch or use a micro-ATM.

E003_IFSC_CHANGED.fix: Update the IFSC to the new merged-bank code in the application (1-tap update), then re-trigger payment.

E004_NAME_MISMATCH.cause: Name mismatch between Aadhaar and bank account
E004_NAME_MISMATCH.short: Name differs between Aadhaar and bank
E004_NAME_MISMATCH.fix: Correct the differing name token via the correction route, then re-verify the claim.

E005_FUNDS_NOT_RELEASED.cause: Sanction issued but funds not released by ministry
E005_FUNDS_NOT_RELEASED.fix: Escalate with the sanction order number at the district nodal office; track the PFMS stage.

E006_OTHER.fix: Retry after 48 hours; if it persists raise a grievance with the PFMS reference number.

UNKNOWN.fix: Retry after 48 hours; if it persists raise a grievance with the PFMS reference number.
